name: Local web fetch
description: Fetches a web page through a hidden local browser window, extracts the main readable content, and returns a summary plus an artifact reference after client-side network permission classification and enforcement.

localizedDescription.zh-CN: 在客户端完成联网权限分类与执行约束后，通过本地隐藏浏览器窗口加载网页、等待渲染并抽取正文，返回标题、正文摘要、最终 URL 及落盘的 artifact 引用。
localizedDescription.en-US: Fetches a web page through a hidden local browser window, extracts the main readable content, and returns a summary plus an artifact reference after client-side network permission classification and enforcement.

url.description: The absolute http(s) URL of the page to fetch.

waitForRender.description: Whether to wait for client-side rendering (JS-driven pages) before extracting content. Defaults to true.

timeoutMs.description: Navigation timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 30000.
